display_name: Phase1 可学习复数滤波系数恢复网络
description: 学习从接收 IQ、DURA 输出及冻结地面基座特征预测逐窗复数与共轭 FIR 校正系数。

data.representation: Phase1 source paired received and clean IQ, frozen DURA anchor and Tri-SIG-TIME features
data.tx_sets_ref: Six original classes; no TX labels in restorer training
data.target_panel: 168000 Phase1 physical records x seven views
data.actual_training_labels: No TX labels; source paired L_s/U_s IQ only; no U_s labels, V or test IQ
data.augmentation: Source 20 views then repeat first 10; random order with 25% clean identity

permissions.regime: Phase1 L_s/U_s source paired IQ and frozen DURA/Tri-SIG-TIME SSL; no source TX labels/V/test during training
permissions.query_use: Frozen per-record received IQ, DURA and F only; no clean or label at inference
permissions.claim_scope: Previously observed single-seed Phase1 development test, not blind

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen original DURA E20 and Tri-SIG-TIME SSL E50; new zero-output FIR-coefficient Transformer
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: DURA original 7/63/30 source-only metadata and pinned release; F exact original checkpoint ancestry and matching L_s/U_s IDs; DURA SHA bound into field checkpoint
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Both inherited Phase1 models are source-only and frozen; generation field from scratch
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed E30, no target-dependent model selection

metric_names: Tri-SIG-TIME raw clean, per-scene raw and restored accuracy, macro F1 and clean-relative gap
dimensions: 168000 Phase1 ground test physical records x seven views
metrics_plan.targets_ref: Each of six restored practical scenes within 3 percentage points of same reader raw clean; restored clean degradation at most 1 percentage point

notes: 输入接收 IQ、冻结 DURA 输出、Tri-SIG-TIME SSL 对 DURA 的冻结特征和类别分数；Transformer 预测 9 tap 复数直通滤波器与共轭滤波器的系数，作用于 DURA IQ。
只在源训练阶段，使用每条源 clean IQ 求逐窗 9 tap 特权 ridge 滤波目标，ridge 0.0001；特权目标和预测校正均截断至 DURA 范数 20%。推理不提供 clean 或滤波真系数。
损失为 0.7×预测波形对截断特权目标的归一化均方差 + 0.3×预测波形对源 clean 的归一化均方差。无标签训练，F 和 DURA 全程冻结。
在此前固定源域小样本分析中，20% 截断保留了 9 tap 特权波形的教师一致性结果；特权拟合使用 clean 且不等于可部署模型或测试性能。
CPU 实际权重两条 L_s 和 GPU B128 L_s smoke 后丢弃临时权重，正式重新初始化；不读取任何 TX 标签、U_s 标签、V 或测试 IQ 训练。
固定 E30、14790 更新，20 个源视图重复前 10 个，25% clean 身份输入。七视图全部预测固定后才连接真值。
Phase1 开发测试先前已经观察，非独立盲测；逐场景同时报告百分点与相对百分比下降和 clean 防护。

rows.method: Source-distilled widely-linear bounded nine-tap FIR coefficient prediction
rows.purpose: Predict physically structured paired-source FIR correction without privileged clean IQ at inference
rows.seed_notes: Model 2026092701, order 2026110104, training noise 2026110105, fixed inference noise template 2026110103; existing Phase1 split and views
rows.scenario: Phase1 R07 L_s/U_s training; fixed Phase1 clean and six practical received views
